profile.headline: DevSecOps Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a DevSecOps and Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building secure, scalable software and cloud-native solutions. Over the past year, I’ve focused on designing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines with integrated quality and security gates, automating deployments across multiple environments, managing AWS infrastructure with Terraform, and supporting application deployments to Amazon EKS. I also create technical documentation that helps standardize processes and improve team collaboration.

My background includes full-stack development with Python (Django), Java (Spring Boot), Go, React, AWS, and cloud infrastructure. I focus on building high-quality, maintainable systems with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and security. I bring a strong product mindset, collaborate effectively across remote teams, and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that make software delivery faster and more dependable.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered scalable, production-grade software solutions using Java, Go (Golang), Python, and ReactJS, contributing to both backend services and frontend experiences in a cloud-native environment powered by AWS.

Designed and deployed distributed microservices using Go, Java, and Python, focusing on performance optimization, maintainability, and modular design.

Delivered full-stack features and client-facing functionality with ReactJS, closely aligned with product roadmaps and user needs.

Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines on AWS, leveraging tools like Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions for streamlined deployment and observability.

Practiced test-driven development and developed automated testing suites for robust, high-quality code.

Partnered cross-functionally with product and design teams to transform business requirements into well-prioritized technical implementations.

Supported legacy codebases and contributed to modernization efforts using Python for data processing tasks and backend service integration.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Dr. Xiaopeng Zhao to develop a robotics project integrating chess to promote STEM education.
• Conducted research and analysis to enhance project effectiveness and engagement.
• Organized workshops and presentations for K-12 students to showcase the project's impact.
• Implemented innovative teaching methods to inspire students' interest in STEM fields.

positions.title: Office Assistant

• Provided academic and reception assistance at the Office of Diversity Programs, supporting recruitment and retention initiatives.
• Tutored students in Computer Science to enhance their skills and prepare them for upcoming assignments.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Dr. Ayanna Howard on "An Accessible Coding Curriculum for Engaging Students with Special Needs in Afterschool Programs."
• Developed API for robotic platform and software interface for coding curriculum with Arduino UNO board.
• Placed third in 2020 TLSAMP Research Conference Poster Competition.
